quizName: DMV Practice Test #3 20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: As your motorcycle goes faster, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Shift up to higher gears.
questions.explanation: You must shift into higher gears as your motorcycle speeds up.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Wear a jacket only at night.
Wear a jacket only when it is cold.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket.
questions.explanation: Always wear a sturdy jacket with long sleeves when riding, no matter what the weather is.

questions.question: How do you know if your motorcycle fits you properly?

options.text: Your feet touch the ground when you sit on the seat.
The seat is no more than 10 inches above your waist when you stand next to the motorcycle.
The handlebars are above your head when you sit down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your feet touch the ground when you sit on the seat.
questions.explanation: Your feet must touch the ground when you sit on your motorcycle. Riding a motorcycle that does not fit your body is unsafe.

questions.question: When a rider wears a helmet during a crash, they are:

options.text: Less likely to survive than someone without a helmet.
Just as likely to survive as someone without a helmet.
More likely to survive than someone without a helmet.

questions.correctAnswerText: More likely to survive than someone without a helmet.
questions.explanation: Riders wearing helmets are three times more likely to survive head injuries than riders without helmets, regardless of speed.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Slow down or change lanes to let them pass.
Speed up to create distance between you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down or change lanes to let them pass.
questions.explanation: If it is safe, change lanes and let the tailgater pass. Speeding up will only make them tailgate you at a higher speed, which increases danger.

questions.question: What should you do when the lights on a railroad crossing sign are flashing?

options.text: Stop and wait until the train passes.
Go slowly and look both ways.
Turn around and find another route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait until the train passes.
questions.explanation: When approaching a railroad crossing with flashing lights, you must stop completely and wait until the train passes and the lights stop flashing. Never try to beat a train across the tracks.

questions.question: How is alcohol different from other beverages?

options.text: It does not affect the body.

questions.correctAnswerText: It enters the bloodstream immediately.
questions.explanation: Alcohol does not need to be digested. It passes directly through the stomach and small intestine walls, enters the bloodstream, and reaches the brain quickly.

questions.question: What is the best way to help others see your motorcycle?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep your headlight on.
questions.explanation: Keep your headlight on at all times to help others see your motorcycle. Motorcycles made in the U.S. after 1978 turn on the headlight automatically when running. Always check that your headlight works before each ride.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what should riders do?

options.text: Keep safe following distances from each other.
Follow each other as closely as possible.
Not worry about the distance between riders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep safe following distances from each other.
questions.explanation: Riders in a group should use a staggered formation. This lets riders stay close together while keeping safe distances between them.

questions.question: What should you wear to improve your chances of surviving a crash?
questions.correctAnswerText: A DOT-approved helmet.
questions.explanation: A helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) standards gives the best head and neck protection. Wearing a properly fitted, quality helmet is the single best thing you can do to survive a crash.

questions.question: What does a solid white line on the side of the road mean?

options.text: The right edge of a traffic lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right edge of a traffic lane.
questions.explanation: A solid white line marks the right edge of a traffic lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Merge
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that traffic will merge ahead.

questions.question: Why should you use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds that may show bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To check if drivers behind you see that you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors to make sure drivers behind you see you stopping and are reacting properly to your actions.

questions.question: What should a motorcycle rider do to reduce collision risk?

options.text: Keep enough space between yourself and other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep enough space between yourself and other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Always leave enough space around your motorcycle. Maintain this space when following, being followed, passing, or being passed by other vehicles.

questions.question: How should you load saddlebags?

options.text: Put equal weight in each bag.
Put different amounts of weight in each bag.
Put all the weight in one bag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Put equal weight in each bag.
questions.explanation: Load both saddlebags with about the same weight. Uneven weight can make the motorcycle pull to one side.

questions.question: What is a benefit of keeping space between you and other vehicles?

options.text: You can draft off other vehicles better.
You have more time to react to other drivers' movements.

questions.correctAnswerText: You have more time to react to other drivers' movements.
questions.explanation: Keep space around your motorcycle at all times. This gives you more time to respond to hazards and more room to move safely.

questions.question: What is the best footwear for motorcyclists?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sturdy boots
questions.explanation: Leather boots give the best foot protection when riding. They should be high and sturdy to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: What material gives the best crash protection?
questions.correctAnswerText: Leather or synthetic materials
questions.explanation: Leather or synthetic materials provide the best protection in a crash. Always wear long pants and a jacket while riding.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol and drugs are used together?

options.text: They are less dangerous than using either alone.
Their effects can be stronger than using either alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Their effects can be stronger than using either alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, can impair your riding. These effects become even more dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from your body?
questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. No other methods can speed up this process.
